query:
SELECT w.id
    , w.name
    , (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM members_workplaces mw
        JOIN members m ON m.id = mw.member_id
        WHERE mw.workplace_id = w.id AND m.left_at IS NULL
      )::bigint AS "member_count!: i64"
FROM workplaces w
WHERE w.keycloak_executive_group_id = ANY($1)
ORDER BY w.name
